name: Slate
description: The workspace: notes, subscriptions and product metrics in one place.
notes: Notes feel like Notion: toggles, a grouped / menu with previews, comments in the margin, an icon and cover on each note, and the bars hide while you type
Recently deleted has Delete for good on each note and an Empty button; a note with words but no title is kept as Untitled instead of lost
Slate Notes opens on your notes list with a big New note button, and Space on an empty line opens the assistant box
The Add icon and Add cover row sits in the space above the title, so the title stays level with the + and an empty note no longer shows a scrollbar
